name: The Last of Us: Post-Pandemic Edition
summary: The Last of Us: Post-Pandemic Edition is a special edition of The Last of Us released exclusively in North America for PlayStation 3. It includes the game on disc in a SteelBook case, a 12-inch premium statue of Joel and Ellie by Project Triforce, a variant cover of The Last of Us: American Dreams #1 comic, and a sheet of Naughty Dog stickers. The edition also comes with two downloadable content packs: the Sights & Sounds Pack (digital soundtrack, PS3 dynamic theme, and character avatars) and the Survival Pack (multiplayer bonuses, in-game currency, weapon upgrades, and unlockable character skins).
